J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF 51: compatibility-difference list. Existing owners confirmed on main: doc/catalogues/sign_intrinsic_16_9_189.json for SIGN negative-zero behavior; doc/catalogues/numeric_editing_general_rules_13_7_2_1.json S13.7.2.1-004 for the sentence that the representation of a negative internal value in I, F, E, EN, ES, EX, D, and G output shall be prefixed with a minus sign; doc/catalogues/f_editing_13_7_2_3_2.json S13.7.2.3.2-012 for finite F output; doc/catalogues/e_and_d_editing_13_7_2_3_3.json S13.7.2.3.3-004 for finite E and D output; doc/catalogues/en_editing_13_7_2_3_4.json S13.7.2.3.4-005 for finite EN output; doc/catalogues/es_editing_13_7_2_3_5.json S13.7.2.3.5-005 for finite ES output; and doc/catalogues/generalized_real_and_complex_editing_13_7_5_2_3.json S13.7.5.2.3-005 for finite G output. The formatted-output negative-zero plan is guarded: use IEEE_ARITHMETIC, proceed only when `IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0)` is true and `IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(IEEE_COPY_SIGN(0.0, -1.0))` confirms that the constructed zero is negative, write that value with `(LZP,F5.1)`, and expect exactly `' -0.0'`. The field has width five: 13.7.2.1 p1 item (3) and 13.7.2.3.2 p11 require the minus sign for a negative internal value; 13.7.2.3.2 p11 permits an optional zero immediately to the left of the decimal symbol for a magnitude less than one, and 13.8.5 p1-p2 says LZP sets leading-zero mode PRINT so the processor shall produce that leading zero; 13.7.2.1 p1 item (4) right-justifies those four nonblank characters with one leading blank. Unsupported or non-distinguishing branches record no assertion. Constant-expression and automatic-object classification remain owned by doc/catalogues/constant_expression_10_1_12.json and doc/catalogues/automatic_data_objects_8_3.json.
